title: Neuroca source artifact record

sha256.description: Digest asserted for the identified source artifact or package. INCLUDED exact-byte copies should match; selected documents/packages may require a separate copied-byte digest and an explicit discrepancy record.

description: Normalized source-artifact record. CSV columns use display names (for example Artifact_ID, Original_Path_or_Artifact and SHA256). Source/package digests may differ from selected copied-document digests; do not silently replace either assertion.
